name: Mahou Shounen Wan-Wan!
source:
Mahou Shounen Wan-Wan! is a Kinetic Novel with Turn Based Combat about Shiro Watanabe, an ordinary high school boy that, after a fated encounter, gains the power to purify the Tainted, everyday objects infected with a poison that threatens the fate of the entire universe!

And so, he and his companion Inu join forces to protect those he loves by purifying the poison from everything it has contained, in a quest where he might get more than what he bargained for!

[From [url=https://axlelism.itch.io/mashowan-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
魔法少年万万！《渡边四郎》是一部回合制战斗动感小说，讲述的是一个普通的高中生渡边四郎，在一次命中注定的邂逅之后，获得了净化被污染的日常物品的力量，这些物品感染了威胁整个宇宙命运的毒药！

因此，他和他的同伴犬联手，净化毒药中的一切成分，保护他所爱的人，他的追求可能会超出他的预期！

[来自[url=https://axlelism.itch.io/mashowan-demo]itch.io[/url]]
